subject: science
title: Alive, once alive or never alive

cards.front: alive
cards.back: Something that is alive now. It moves, grows, needs food and water, and has young.
cards.say: alive. Something that is alive now. It moves, grows, needs food and water, and has young.

cards.front: once alive
cards.back: Something that was alive but is not now, or that came from a living thing. A dry leaf is once alive.
cards.say: once alive. Something that was alive but is not now, or that came from a living thing. A dry leaf is once alive.

cards.front: never alive
cards.back: Something that has never been alive. A stone is never alive.
cards.say: never alive. Something that has never been alive. A stone is never alive.

cards.front: Is a horse alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Alive. A horse eats, grows and has foals.
cards.say: Is a horse alive, once alive or never alive? Alive. A horse eats, grows and has foals.

cards.front: Is a wooden table alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. Wood comes from a tree that was alive.
cards.say: Is a wooden table alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. Wood comes from a tree that was alive.

cards.front: Is a plastic cup alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Never alive. Plastic is made in a factory.
cards.say: Is a plastic cup alive, once alive or never alive? Never alive. Plastic is made in a factory.

cards.front: Is a dead leaf alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. It used to be part of a living plant.
cards.say: Is a dead leaf alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. It used to be part of a living plant.

cards.front: Is a pebble alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Never alive. A pebble is a small stone.
cards.say: Is a pebble alive, once alive or never alive? Never alive. A pebble is a small stone.

cards.front: Is a daisy alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Alive. A daisy grows and needs water.
cards.say: Is a daisy alive, once alive or never alive? Alive. A daisy grows and needs water.

cards.front: Is a wool jumper alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. Wool comes from a sheep.
cards.say: Is a wool jumper alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. Wool comes from a sheep.

cards.front: Is a coin alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Never alive. A coin is made of metal.
cards.say: Is a coin alive, once alive or never alive? Never alive. A coin is made of metal.

cards.front: Is a paper page alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. Paper is made from trees.
cards.say: Is a paper page alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. Paper is made from trees.

cards.front: Is a shell on the beach alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. It was the home of a sea animal.
cards.say: Is a shell on the beach alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. It was the home of a sea animal.

cards.front: Is a cotton T-shirt alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. Cotton comes from a plant.
cards.say: Is a cotton T-shirt alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. Cotton comes from a plant.

cards.front: Is a glass bottle alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Never alive. Glass is made from sand.
cards.say: Is a glass bottle alive, once alive or never alive? Never alive. Glass is made from sand.

cards.front: What do all living things do?
cards.back: They move, grow, need food and water, breathe, make young and sense things.
cards.say: What do all living things do? They move, grow, need food and water, breathe, make young and sense things.

cards.front: Do living things need food?
cards.back: Yes. Animals eat food. Plants make their own food.
cards.say: Do living things need food? Yes. Animals eat food. Plants make their own food.

cards.front: Can a rock make young ones?
cards.back: No. A rock is never alive.
cards.say: Can a rock make young ones? No. A rock is never alive.

cards.front: What does it mean to reproduce?
cards.back: To make young ones, like a hen laying eggs.
cards.say: What does it mean to reproduce? To make young ones, like a hen laying eggs.

cards.front: Do plants move?
cards.back: Yes, in small ways. They grow and turn towards the light.
cards.say: Do plants move? Yes, in small ways. They grow and turn towards the light.

cards.front: Do living things breathe?
cards.back: Yes. Animals take in air, and plants take in air too.
cards.say: Do living things breathe? Yes. Animals take in air, and plants take in air too.

cards.front: Is a fallen branch alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. It came from a living tree.
cards.say: Is a fallen branch alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. It came from a living tree.

cards.front: Is a cow alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Alive. A cow eats, grows and has calves.
cards.say: Is a cow alive, once alive or never alive? Alive. A cow eats, grows and has calves.

cards.front: Is a leather shoe alive, once alive or never alive?
cards.back: Once alive. Leather comes from animal skin.
cards.say: Is a leather shoe alive, once alive or never alive? Once alive. Leather comes from animal skin.
